title:
ASKING MUSLIMS IF THEY
FEEL SAFE IN ISRAEL 🇮🇱
beats: S42-b hook with the question: Moroccan woman in a red hijab, Old City: as a Muslim, do you feel safe? Yeah, definitely. Of course.
S18-g Carlos from Jaffa: as a Muslim, same rights as a Jew? Of course, of course, we do, yes we do
S32-b STRONGEST: Yusuf, bakery manager: it's just on the media, it's the opposite
S17-e young woman in hijab, Jaffa seafront: no, no, we live here. Freely? Yeah. I'm from Jerusalem.
S6-a Mahmoud behind the bakery counter: as a Muslim, you feel safe here? Of course.
S8-a Ahmadi Muslim in the mosque: practice your prayer safely here? Yes, I do.
S37-a Anas at the Zaatar counter: what is it like? It's very good. Safe to be Muslim? Yes.
S29-c END: woman in hijab, thumbs up on the beach: I'm Jewish, you're Muslim, we are one. Exactly. Inshallah, no war.

captionFix.match: Israel, as a Muslim, do you have the same rights as a Jew?
